fusions.name: Fan Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes a woven sea fan at an enemy up to 4 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, with a 25% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Cast Mesh
fusions.desc: Casts a mesh of woven coral 3.5 tiles ahead of you that deals 8 damage to everything in it, with a 20% chance to leave each target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Lacework Mantle
fusions.desc: Drapes a woven coral lattice over you that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 8% while it holds.

fusions.name: Folded Light
fusions.desc: 20% of the elemental damage you take is folded back onto whoever dealt it. Your armour rises by 5%.
